question: In the context of the Internet, which of the followings is NOT a protocol?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PPT.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The functioning of the Internet is not controlled by any particular organization.
 
• It is managed by a group of voluntary organizations.
 
• These voluntary organizations have formed the Internet Society.
 
• They decide on the rules, known as protocols, for communication over the Internet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Name**
 **Used for**
 
 

 **HTTP**
 HyperText Transfer Protocol is used to transfer the hypertext 
 
 

 **FTP**
 File Transfer Protocol is used to transfer binary and text files over the Internet
 
 

 **File**
 Local file 
 
 

 **Telnet **
 For remote login over a TCP/IP connection 
 
 

 
 
**TCP/IP**

 
(Transmission Control Protocol /Internet Protocol.)

 
 
 
TCP/IP consists of a set of two protocols i.e. Transfer Control Protocol and Internet Protocol.

 
Transfer Control Protocol controls the flow of data and is a

 reliable service protocol. Every computer in a network has a unique

 The IP address associated with it. IP identifies and reaches the target

 computer on the network.

 
 
 

 **News**
 Newsgroup /News article 
 
 

 **UDP**
 **User Datagram Packet **is used to transfer data between two computers.

 It is an unreliable protocol, offering no guarantee for data delivery
